title: Portable bundle frontmatter
description: Flat frontmatter of bundles/<slug>/bundle.md (Skill 5). Body is the human README: what it is, how to upload, what the operator still does by hand.
$comment: Account state never appears here; it lives in bundles/<slug>/canva/<account-id>.md, which is git-ignored (Decision 11).

bundle_id.description: Bundle slug; the bundles/<bundle_id> directory name.

title.description: Human title of the bundled deck.

library_version.description: Commit sha of the library the bundle was exported from; also recorded in bundle-manifest.json.

layout_ids.description: Layouts vendored into the bundle. The bundle must not reference any layout outside this list.

slide_count.description: Number of slides; must equal the page count created in Canva (acceptance).

fonts.description: Every family used across the bundled slides.

fonts_native.description: True when every family is Canva-native, so a foreign account needs no font upload.

routes_supported.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/route.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
routes_supported.description: Upload routes this bundle ships the artefacts for.

brand.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/brand.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
brand.description: Brand of the bundled deck. A public bundle is normally neutral.

pairing.description: Named font pairing carried by the bundled slides.

content_public.description: Decision 4: export refuses unless this is true or -Public was passed. Never inferred.

license.description: License the bundle is published under, or "all-rights-reserved".
